label: Agricultural employment share
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = Eurostat nama_10_a10_e pinned na_item=EMP_DC, unit=PC_TOT_PER, nace_r2=A ("Agriculture, forestry and fishing" — the door's own aggregate label): same universe and discipline as industrial (34 countries, aggregates dropped logged incl. the EA two-letter edge, no sex dimension, FR 1995-2024 full annual series 4.4 -> 2.3). Witness tier = the ILO modeled agriculture shares, world 1991-2024. Root pair eurostat_na/ilo_modelled.

notes: The honest face of the corpus's smallest economy metric: Todd's 1841 Britain / 1841 USA / 1985 Turkey prints are census-era BOOK tables (curated territory), the living wire covers the accounts universe 1995-2024 (per-country start years vary — the canonical clips at each country's own NA start), and the world/witness face carries the agrarian South the accounts universe lacks. The same door as industrial: one nace pin away, the probe record shared, the construction-seam question absent (agriculture is definitional everywhere). The SEX-AGE detail doors (lfsa_egan2's A split, the SAL_DC/SELF_DC items) are recorded unwired in sources.yaml with industrial's.
